title: Authentication required
detail: The server returned HTTP 401 (code: invalid_request_error). The server's message (untrusted, quoted): "You did not provide an API key. You need to provide your API key in the Authorization header, using Bearer auth (e.g. 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SECRET_KEY'). See https://stripe.com/docs/api#authent…"
what_you_should_do: Do not retry without credentials. Ask the user to authenticate or provide credentials.
